facts.text: Founded in 1876, Prairie View A&M University is the second-oldest public institution of higher education in Texas and the third-largest HBCU in the nation.

sources.title: pvamu commemorates 135th anniversary of the second morrill act
sources.quote: PRAIRIE VIEW A&M UNIVERSITY, founded in 1876, is the second oldest public institution of higher education in the state of Texas and the third largest Historically Black College/University (HBCU) in the nation.
